Heal potions can be used to restore {{Health||50}}. They can be found in the [[dungeon]] or crafted at the [[Alchemy workbench (tier I)]].

==Quest==
===Lost Memories===
Upon first meeting [[Clotho]] she will tell you that she has lost her mind. She gives you a quest to help restore her mind, asking you to either bring her a [[heal potion]] or bring her the ingredients: A [[cauldron]] from the [[Blacksmith]], a [[bee]] and some [[life powder|yellow powder]].
